lore_anchors.definition: A traditional Chinese ceremonial curved object, often made of jade or wood, symbolizing authority and good fortune. In xianxia, jade ruyi are common magical weapons or tools.
A legendary, high-damage thunder orb bred from the user's own cultivation base. It is considered a "last resort" trump card because activating it consumes the user's cultivation.
